title: 師傅這首是DJ版
mood: sleepy turning giddy, laughing at himself
subject: a ride-hailing passenger in a suit at 2 a.m. whose driver only plays DJ remixes of old love songs, and who ends up asking to go around the block again
caption: Douyin car-DJ remix pop in the Chinese 車載DJ / 慢搖 style, an old Mandopop love-song melody rebuilt for a club. A hard four-on-the-floor kick with an offbeat open hi-hat; a plucked supersaw synth lead doubling the vocal melody between lines; a sidechained pumping synth bass; snare-roll risers into each chorus. Loud, compressed and bright with a heavy sub low end, mixed like a car stereo turned all the way up. Male tenor, casual and conversational in the verses, belting the chorus like a KTV regular. 128 BPM, A minor. Sleepy turning giddy, laughing at himself. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no dubstep wobble drop, no rap verse, no acoustic ballad intro.
lyrics:
[Intro - four-on-the-floor kick and plucked synth lead]

[Verse 1]
凌晨兩點我叫了一台車
師傅的音響開得像夜店
西裝領帶我只想睡一下
他說老闆你聽這首經典

[Pre-Chorus]
明明是愛如潮水的旋律
怎麼底下多了動次動次

[Chorus]
師傅 這首是DJ版
後座的窗戶都在震
我說關小聲一點點
他說好 然後再加三格

[Verse 2]
過了三個紅燈我開始點頭
領帶早就塞進公事包
第五首副歌我先唱出口
師傅從後照鏡對我笑

[Pre-Chorus]
導航說還有十二分鐘
我說要不要繞一下路

[Chorus - snare roll, full drop]
師傅 這首是DJ版
整條高架都在晃
我說再大聲一點點
他說好 我們再繞一圈

[Outro - synth lead and kick fade]
到了樓下我還不想下車
五顆星 備註下次還放這首
